layman_headline: Fearful market with weak setups — patience is the best trade right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a 'Fear' zone at 30/100, and Bitcoin dominance is high at 56.7%, which means money is flowing toward Bitcoin and away from smaller coins. The candidates on the swing trade list are mostly stablecoins, already-extended pumps (BTW up 168% in a week with an RSI of 85), or coins with incomplete technical data. There's no clean entry with defined risk/reward that meets our standards right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. Set price alerts on Solana around $73-74 and watch for a cleaner pullback entry. Don't chase anything that's already run up significantly.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is extremely weak this cycle. BTW (RSI 84.7, +168% in 7d) is dangerously overbought. PUMP (+27.3% in 7d) has already moved. CRV (+16% in 7d) lacks RSI/MACD data to confirm. FDUSD, USDG, and USDD are stablecoins with no swing potential. FET is down 96% from ATH with no catalyst. SOL is the best-quality asset but is mid-range without a clear technical dip to buy. With Fear/Greed at 30 and trending up from 28.1, we're approaching conditions where a bounce could materialize, but we need either a sharper pullback in quality alts or a sentiment shift past 35+ to confirm. Capital preservation is paramount.
